text: Owner-directed 9 October continuation: implement the public reference and named reconstruction over the already qualified producer seam. A live cycle was verified: both consumer beads depended on G1, whose AC1/AC4 require those consumers. Replace only those coarse blocking edges with completed S2a-4 and S2b-3/4/5 prerequisites; G1 now depends on completion of these existing consumer beads. This preserves acceptance and other prerequisites, keeps G1/open optional court open, and creates no substitute ticket. Sources/receipts: strict content a2d795b; ONNX registration 658fec8b/c4010ed8; historical parity71a79818/658b1d94; StageTrace95ba0e4d/655c0b39, hosted-qualified through cb6e3522. Reference v1 will accept only gated canonical controlled evidence, a source-bound single-level universe, finite positive temperature, uniform state prior, retained five external alternatives and AlignState-keyed output. Mixed-grain/foreign nominations refuse before normalization; overflow, Unranked and prior-only/unassessable target rows remain accounted NotComputed. Full provider execution authority, hierarchical cut production, codecs/facade and calibration remain separate acceptance.
